Chandigarh Electricity Department,** Superintending Engineer, Electricity “OP” Circle, Room No. 511, 5[th] Floor, UT Secretariat (Deluxe) Building, Sector 9D, U.T., Chandigarh - 160009. ** Respondents** ## **ORDER** The Applicant, Bhakra Beas Management Board (hereinafter referred to as **“** BBMB”) has filed the instant Interlocutory Application (hereinafter referred to as the “IA”) seeking waiver of the filing fee of Rs. 25,00,000/- in respect of the Petition (Diary No. 54/2026) for the adoption of discovered through the transparent competitive bidding process. 2. The Petitioner, Bhakra Beas Management Board (hereinafter referred to as **“** BBMB”), has filed the Petition under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking adoption/approval of tariff for 1 MW Power from surface Hydrokinetic Power Project under Renewable Energy Service Company (‘RESCO’) mode for 40 years, at a tariff of Rs. 3.39/kWh determined through competitive bidding process conducted by BBMB. 3. The Applicant in the IA has submitted as under: (a) BBMB is a statutory body constituted under the provisions of Section 79(1) read with Section 80(6) of the Punjab Re-organisation Act, 1966, on the re-organisation of the erstwhile State of Punjab on 1.11.1966. BBMB has been engaged in regulating the supply of water, generation and transmission of power from the Bhakra Nangal and Beas Projects, and in making the power Order in Diary No. IA. 145/2026 In Diary No. 54/2026 Page 2 available to the Partner States, namely the States of Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, and the Union Territory of Chandigarh. (b) Pursuant to the mandate to explore renewable energy opportunities, BBMB issued the Tender Document on 23.05.2025 for Design, engineering, supply, installation, commissioning, own, operation, and Maintenance for a period of 40 years of 4x250 kWh Surface Hydrokinetic Power Plant at Tail Race Channel of Kotla Hydro Power Station, BBMB under RESCO mode. (c) Pursuant to the tender, BBMB issued a Letter of Award to MACLEC as Power Developer on 23.10.2025 for design, engineering, supply, installation, commissioning, own, operation, and maintenance for a period of 40 years of 4X250 kW Surface Hydrokinetic Power Plant at Tail Race Channel of Kotla Hydro Power Station, BBMB under RESCO mode, for supply of power to BBMB at the lowest discovered tariff of Rs. 3.39 per Unit. Accordingly, BBMB has filed the Petition on 29.1.2026 seeking adoption of the tariff discovered through a transparent competitive bidding process. (d) As, the present Petition pertains to the adoption of tariff for a small pilot renewable energy project of only 1 MW capacity, which is proposed to be developed using Surface Hydrokinetic technology, an emerging renewable energy technology. (e) Considering the nature of the project and the small capacity involved, the requirement to deposit the filing fee of Rs. 25,00,000/- would be disproportionate to the nature and scale of the project, particularly when the Order in Diary No. IA. 145/2026 In Diary No. 54/2026 Page 3 Petition merely seeks regulatory adoption of tariff discovered through a transparent competitive bidding process. 4. In the above facts and circumstances, the Applicant has prayed for the waiver of payment of the court fees. 5. The IA is being decided by circulation. 6. We have considered the submissions of the Applicant. The Applicant has submitted that the requirement to deposit the filing fee of Rs. 25,00,000/- is wholly disproportionate to the nature and scale of the project, particularly given that it is a small-capacity pilot project based on emerging renewable energy technology. Considering the submissions of the Applicant, we find that the instant case is fit for exercising the power to relax to reduce the filing fee for the adoption of tariff. Accordingly, in exercise of the power conferred under Regulation 13 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Payment of Fees) Regulations, 2012, which empowers the Commission to relax any provisions of said Regulations, in appropriate cases, the Commission taking into consideration the nature and scale of the project relaxes the provisions of Regulation 4 of the Payment of Fees Regulations 2012. Accordingly, the Petitioner is directed to deposit a sum of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only), as application fee for the adoption of tariff for the 1 MW Surface Hydrokinetic Pilot Power Project. 7. Further, the observations/findings in this IA are case-specific and shall not be cited as a precedent in any other proceedings. Order in Diary No. IA. 145/2026 In Diary No. 54/2026 Page 4 8. The Registry is directed to list the main Petition (Diary No. 54/2026) on **25.3.2026** , upon receipt of the filing fee of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs. One lakh only) from the Petitioner. 9. IA is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/sd/sd/sd/- - ( **Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.)
